description: This file contains UI rendering functions for agent tools and skills panels, including tool access controls, skill allowlisting, and session-based tool availability, using lit-html.

methods.name: renderToolBadges
methods.description: Renders badges for tools based on source and optionality.

methods.name: renderEffectiveToolBadge
methods.description: Returns a string badge indicating the tool's connection type.

methods.name: renderAgentTools
methods.description: Main function to render the agent tools management UI, including profile, tool list, and controls.

methods.name: renderAgentSkills
methods.description: Main function to render the agent skills management UI, including allowlist, filtering, and skill groups.

methods.name: renderAgentSkillGroup
methods.description: Renders a group of skills with toggle controls.

methods.name: renderAgentSkillRow
methods.description: Renders a single skill row with toggle and status info.
